zero_strength_equals_baseline.interpretation: alpha=0 reproduces the baseline accuracy exactly in every cell. The preference-change deviation is bounded by bf16 rounding on near-tied prompts and is ~1e-3 logits against a ~8.65 margin (0.03%), i.e. float reduction order, not intervention leakage.

sign_asymmetry.caveat: v_l = mean(A) - mean(B), so +z pushes toward A and -z toward B; asymmetry reflects asymmetric propagation of the two halves, not an assumed symmetry
